messages:
Alex (Support): Hey team, AcmeMaps just flagged a sharp p99 regression after we onboarded redwood-open-7b-v2 with the new tokenizer (bpe-v3). p50/p95 are OK, p99 jumped from ~2.1s -> ~4.8s. They provided request IDs and traces.

Meera (Eng Runtime): Can you paste the model_id, tokenizer version, and a minimal repro? Also link to the Console view (latency by pctl) and timeline.

Alex (Support): Model: redwood-open-7b-v2
Tokenizer: bpe-v3 (replaced bpe-v2 yesterday at 09:12 UTC)
Customer repro (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-open-7b-v2","prompt":"<20k chat history>\nUser: what's the best route?","max_tokens":512}'
```
They included a flamegraph and a p99 spike around the decode loop.

Sam (ML Eng): Initial thought: tokenizer changes caused tokenization expansion on typical long-context prompts (more tokens for same semantic content). That increases per-request token count and breaks our batching heuristics. Also saw a change in BPE merges that turns some sequences into more, smaller tokens — increases decode steps.

Sam (ML Eng): Quick diff (handy example):
```
- bpe-v2: "—" -> often tokenized as 1 token
+ bpe-v3: "—" -> sometimes split into 2 tokens
```
Which, when repeated across 20k input, amplifies.

Meera (Eng Runtime): That would explain p99 tails. Runtime batches by token budget; if token count per request jumps, tail queuing and memory pressure go up. Two immediate mitigations: pin the customer to previous tokenizer/model version or force a tokenizer_override at the API layer to align with previous behavior. Medium-term: add a tokenizer-diff gate to onboarding.

Ingrid (SRE): Immediate hotfix recommendation: rollback the model and disable prefix KV caching for that model until we confirm tokenization parity. Commands to run from ops console:
```
redwood models update redwood-open-7b-v2 --config 'prefix_kv_cache=false'
redwood deploy rollback --model redwood-open-7b-v2 --to-version 3
```
I'll schedule the rollback with deploy window now.

Alex (Support): Customer accepted rollback as temporary mitigation. Initiating and asking them to re-run their repro after rollback.

Deploy Bot: Deployment redwood-open-7b-v2 rolled back to version 3 by Ingrid at 2026-03-15T12:03:21Z :white_check_mark:

Meera (Eng Runtime): I'll reproduce in staging with their exact 20k prompt and collect token counts, per-layer timings, and KV cache hit/miss stats. Script I'm running (staging):
```
# staging repro script (sanitized)
python repro_token_stats.py --model redwood-open-7b-v2 --tokenizer bpe-v3 --prompt samples/20k_history.txt
```
I will attach traces to RW-6789. ETA ~3h.

Sam (ML Eng): Adding a gating rule in onboarding CI: compute token-count delta across a canonical prompt set when swapping tokenizers. If delta > 2% for p95 token count, fail onboarding and require manual review. I'll put up a PR today.

Marta (Customer Success): I'll keep AcmeMaps updated, confirm rollback resolved p99 and request permission to run safe experiments in their staging tenant.

Alex (Support): Customer reports initial improvement post-rollback (preliminary). Will verify p99 over next 30m and then close. :thumbsup:

Meera (Eng Runtime): Notes for postmortem:
- Root cause hypothesis: tokenizer change increased tokenization density for long-context inputs -> higher token budgets per request -> heavier batching + queueing + memory GC -> p99 tail.
- Short-term mitigations: rollback, disable prefix_kv_cache for model, reduce batch size/token-budget thresholds for that model.
- Long-term: tokenizer-diff gate, onboarding perf benchmarks including long-context heavy prompts, and automated canary runs that exercise 10k+ context.

Ingrid (SRE): I'll keep the rollback in place as hotfix until we have CI gate and Meera's staging repro confirms parity.

Action items (owners):
- Meera (Eng Runtime): repro & traces -> attach to RW-6789 (ETA 3h)
- Sam (ML Eng): onboarding CI tokenizer-diff gate PR (ETA 2d)
- Ingrid (SRE): maintain rollback, monitor infra for memory pressure (ETA until CI merged)
- Alex / Marta: confirm customer verifies improvement and close ticket (ETA 24h)

Alex (Support): One extra note — customer uses long-context chat with ~20k prompt + many system messages; token amplification matters a lot there. Marking this as high priority for onboarding rules.

Meera (Eng Runtime): RW-6789 created, linking console traces and staging runs when finished. Thanks everyone, will follow up in-thread.
